title: fugaro/installed.json
description: The installation's version record in the runs bucket: the release the last `fugaro update` applied and the release the installation was on before it (internal/installrec, docs/issues-resolved-on-update). The update door writes it; every launcher reads it. A reader that does not know the format refuses the object rather than rewriting it, and the record only ever rises.

format.description: The record's format number. A field never changes meaning, so a later shape that has to change one raises this number instead.

release.description: The release the last update applied: a strict X.Y.Z with no v prefix, which is what updatecheck.CanonicalRelease writes.

previous_release.description: The release the installation was on before the last update, or empty in the first record an installation writes.
